permission_hardening.issue: Recurring loss of +x executable bit on shell scripts due to internal repair scripts (repair_workspace.py/fix_permissions.py) over-correcting to 644.
permission_hardening.resolution: Implemented 'Direct Execution' pattern in Git hooks and hardened the Git index.
actions_taken: Modified .git/hooks/pre-commit to invoke 'bash dev.sh' instead of './dev.sh'
Verified index mode 100755 across all toolchain scripts

new_assets.perf.sh: Performance benchmark for the grav_engine physics loop.
new_assets.resilience_yml: Updated GitHub Action to include performance benchmarking.

opsec_check.warning: Avoid running repair_workspace.py without verifying if it will strip executable bits from the root toolchain.
